ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, be
amended by changing all the RS-3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House)
District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 16-I in the area bounded
by:

A line 208.79 feet north of and parallel to West 70" Street; South Campbell

Avenue; a line 178.79 feet north of and parallel to West 70" Street; and the
public alley next west of and parallel to South Campbell Avenue

to those of a RM-4.5 Residential Multi-Unit District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and

due publication.

Common Address of Property: 6940 South Campbell Avenue
